Use the provided project-owned Mage image ONLY as a style reference: clean modern 2D semi-chibi fantasy world, polished cel shading, crisp simple silhouettes, bright but gentle colors. NO people, no characters, no animals, no writing, no letters, no symbols that read as text, no logo, no border or panels. One coherent quiet environment with a large clean light central clearing (middle 55% is open pale space for a separate unchanged full-body portrait overlay); decorative storytelling objects sit around left/right edges and lower corners, a low ground plane. Landscape composition approximately 3:2. Light, welcoming, whimsical, not photorealistic, no 3D render, no grain. Treat this as a usable web scene, not a poster. Each object must communicate the family learning approach. Arcane & Knowledge: a pale periwinkle-blue magical observatory/library. Side-edge floating books with blank pages, a simple gold armillary sphere, blue/violet crystals and softly suspended geometric constellations; distant rounded arched academy shelves. The middle stays mostly empty pale lilac. Palette periwinkle #6354b8, ink blue and a little cyan/gold. Communicate exploring patterns and connecting knowledge.
